item.title: reports: per-currency totals
item.brief: Implement the reports side of the multi-currency contract: read CSV with optional `currency` column (absent means USD), total per account and currency, print header `account,currency,total_cents` sorted by account then currency, validate currency codes and exit 2 with an stderr message on malformed input. Add unittest cases for new behaviour and old-format input, keep existing tests passing, update README. Commit on the local branch.

state.summary:
Implemented the reports side of the multi-currency contract in the worktree on archon/5jfq624a-reports-per-currency-totals. Committed as e69cc05 on top of 0c0880f, without push. reports.py reads an optional `currency` column (absent means USD), totals per (account, currency), and prints `account,currency,total_cents` sorted by account then currency. A currency that is not exactly [A-Z]{3}, including an empty value in a short row, prints `reports: line N: malformed currency ...` to stderr and exits 2 with no stdout. Old-format input still works and counts as USD. Tests: 5 unittest cases pass with `python3 -m unittest -v`, covering the old format, multi-currency totals, malformed codes (usd, US, USDX, U5D, empty, leading space) and a missing currency value. Before: header `account,total_cents`, no currency handling. Open: the output header and row shape change, so any existing caller parsing the old CLI output will break; the risk is rated high for that reason. The `cargo test` in ledger is not part of this item. No servers or background processes were started. Review: one reviewer (agt_01M7W7GJVMAEN586Z1XXM3WPTT) passed e69cc05 with no blocking findings and confirmed risk high.

item.title: ledger: currency column
item.brief: Implement the ledger side of the multi-currency contract: optional fourth TSV column for ISO 4217 currency (default USD), header `date,account,amount_cents,currency`, validate currency as exactly three uppercase ASCII letters, error naming the line number with exit 2 on bad currency while other input errors keep exit 1. Add cargo tests for the new behaviour, keep existing tests passing, update README. Commit on the local branch.

state.summary:
Ledger currency column implemented on archon/8zmshk2q-ledger-currency-column, committed as dd12cf4 (tree c19d691335bbaabb7739152184bf2a3c6ff00a3d, base ec63a85). Input lines accept an optional fourth TSV column (ISO 4217 shape: exactly three uppercase ASCII letters); a missing column defaults to USD. Output header is now date,account,amount_cents,currency and every row carries its currency. A bad currency prints `line N: bad currency ...` to stderr and exits 2; other input errors still exit 1. parse_line now returns a ParseError enum (BadCurrency / Other) so main picks the exit code. README updated. Checks: cargo test passed 9/9 (2 pre-existing unit tests, 4 new unit tests, 3 new binary tests for exit codes and output) with 0 build warnings, on the final head's tree. rustfmt and clippy are not installed in this environment, so they were not run; formatting was hand-checked. Review: one reviewer (agt_01M7W7HEFDVV2VY7HK2P85FKVY) passed dd12cf4 with no blocking findings. Open follow-ups, all non-blocking and not changed: (1) README says "ISO 4217 code" but the check enforces shape only, so unassigned codes like XYZ pass; (2) an empty fourth column (trailing tab) exits 2 as a bad currency rather than defaulting to USD; (3) parse_line's error type and Entry struct changed, a public API change for any external caller; (4) the field-count error text changed to "expected 3 or 4 ...". The reports repo is out of this stage's scope and belongs to sibling item qi_01M7W7F3N1NHT0P5SN5JFQ624A; I did not touch it. Nothing is left running. Nothing was pushed.
